data.title: How to Collect Antiquities – Andrej Kmeť’s booklet of 1904

data.metaTitle: How to Collect Antiquities – Andrej Kmeť, 1904
data.metaDescription: A slim 1904 booklet by the archaeologist Andrej Kmeť telling the public how to behave on finding archaeological artefacts — advice still valid today.

children.text: This slim but all the more interesting booklet came into my hands. Its author is the legendary Slovak archaeologist Andrej Kmeť; it was published in 1904 and was intended for the general public, to whom it gave instructions on how to behave on finding archaeological artefacts. Many of Kmeť’s pieces of advice and explanations are still valid today, and the booklet ought to be read by everyone who comes across archaeological finds, whether by chance or deliberately. We present the article in its original wording.
